# Baidu

1 endpoint, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 1 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/baidu/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Baidu's organic results for a query, 10, 20 or 50 a page, as deep as Baidu's 750th result. Each result has its position, title, link, the address as the engine shows it, the domain, the snippet, and the date when the engine prints one (as it prints it). `site_name` is the source Baidu names (for example 百度百科), `total_results` Baidu's own count and `related_searches` its related queries. Baidu can return fewer results than asked when a page holds other modules. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to see what Chinese searchers find for a query or to track a site's rank on Baidu.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 10/page by default, max 50; set with `limit` · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/10) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - The search, up to 500 characters, for example heat pump efficiency. · e.g. `热泵`
- `limit` (optional, enum: 10 | 20 | 50) - Results a page: 10 (default), 20 or 50.
- `page` (optional, integer, 1-76) - Page number from 1, up to Baidu's 750th result (16 pages at 50, 76 at 10). Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (from the response contract): {date string|null, displayed_url string|null, domain string|null, position number|null, site_name string|null, snippet string|null, title string|null, url string|null}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.related_searches`, `data.total_results`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/baidu/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=热泵" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
